column2: Creeping things among flying creatures are declared unclean and forbidden, preserving the category's source phrasing.

Self-dead animals may be given to a resident alien or sold to a foreigner, while Israel's holiness bars eating; the milk prohibition names a lamb in the selected text.
The emphatic tithe requirement applies to all seed-produce year by year, preserving scope and recurrence.
The chosen-place meal includes grain, wine and oil tithes and cattle/sheep firstborn for learning lifelong fear of the Lord.
Distance preventing carriage introduces conversion to silver; the chosen name-place and the Lord's blessing both remain conditions in the sentence.
The produce is sold for silver carried in the hands to the chosen place, preserving the exchange and transport sequence.
Silver buys desired cattle, sheep, wine, strong drink or other desired things for household rejoicing before the Lord; repeated desire remains.
The Levite joins the preceding rejoicing because he has no portion or inheritance; an unexpressed do not forsake clause is not imported here.
After three years all that year's tithe is stored in the towns, retaining the selected time wording.
Levite, sojourner, orphan and widow come, eat and are filled, with blessing in all work as the stated purpose.
The release occurs at the seven-year interval; the inherited end-of-seven-years formulation remains.
Every debt owed by the neighbour is released without exaction from a brother, because release has been proclaimed to the Lord.
Foreign debts may be exacted while the brother's debt is released; the distinction remains explicit.
Absence of need is linked with emphatic blessing in the inherited land and continues into the obedience condition.
Diligent hearing, keeping and doing all commandments qualify the preceding promise.
Lending without borrowing and ruling without being ruled express the promised reversal under divine blessing; both pairs remain.
A needy brother in any town must not face withheld affection or a closed hand, preserving the selected emotional and bodily images.
Hands are emphatically opened and a sufficient loan given according to actual need; the repeated need wording remains.
Propose in you for upon you to preserve the selected en soi in the great-sin conclusion, alongside the inward lawless thought and evil eye. Imminent release must not motivate withholding aid.
Both giving and lending according to need remain, without inward grief, followed by blessing in every work and undertaking.
The needy will not cease from the land, so hands must open to poor brother and needy person; the promise in 15:4 is not used to erase this statement.
A sold Hebrew man or woman serves six years and is released in the seventh; the selected masculine continuation after both alternatives is retained.
The released person must not be sent away empty, preserving the repeated release language.
Provision comes generously from sheep, grain and winepress according to the Lord's blessing; the selected grain is not changed to a threshing-floor noun.
Household slavery and redemption in Egypt ground the command to provide on release.
The servant's refusal to leave is explained by love of master and household and well-being with them; the speech and narrative reasons remain distinct.
An awl pierces the ear at the door for permanent household service, with the same treatment specified for the female slave.
The selected yearly-wage wording and six years remain, without substituting a familiar double-wage comparison.
column3: The force of epheteion and the wage calculation require specialist lexical and historical review; the retained construction is provisional.

Such meat may be eaten locally by unclean and clean alike as gazelle or deer, preserving the ordinary-meat comparison.
Blood remains prohibited and is poured on the earth like water, retaining the recurring exception.
The month of new produce and nighttime departure frame Passover, without substituting an unexpressed month-name.

It occurs at the chosen place at sunset in the departure season; both evening and sun-setting remain.

Six days precede the seventh-day concluding feast, with the selected exception for work serving a person's needs retained.

The same broad social groups rejoice in the feast, with the full repeated participant list preserved.
Seven-day celebration at the chosen place and the conditional blessing of produce and work lead to rejoicing; selected if remains.
Every male appears three times yearly at Unleavened Bread, Weeks and Pitching of Tents, and must not appear empty; all occasions remain.
Each gives according to hand-capacity and the received blessing, retaining the selected shift to plural your hands.
Judges and recording officers are appointed town by town and tribe by tribe for righteous judgment.
column3: The exact administrative role of grammatoeisagogeis remains open as at 1:15; no modern office is imposed.
